# Portable Rust under hosts/ that touches no OS API: candidates for shared/.
# Generated by scripts/check_shared_contracts.py --write-baseline.
# May shrink; a new entry needs a reason in review.
# wlp-import (2026-10-17): hosts/capenc/src/wayland/{cursor,format,layout}.rs translate
# PipeWire SPA buffer, chunk and meta layouts into the shared CaptureSurface; only a
# PipeWire consumer uses them (as hosts/linux/src/input/eis.rs for EIS). Move them to
# shared/ when a second PipeWire consumer exists. wayland/telemetry.rs is capenc's
# observability-runtime glue, as hosts/*/src/observability.rs are. The generic lease
# mailbox and damage union moved to arcen_media::video::capture_lease instead.
# wlp-input (2026-10-17): hosts/linux/src/input/edges.rs is the evdev key, button and
# scroll planning split out of the Linux-only uinput.rs so the Xorg uinput devices and
# the session-bound Wayland injector share it. It speaks evdev codes, like input/keymap.rs,
# and moves to shared/ with keymap.rs when an evdev consumer outside hosts/linux exists.
# wlp-auto-speed (2026-10-17): hosts/capenc/src/wayland/pipelines/mod.rs reads capenc's
# own argv into one request and dispatches the Wayland Auto/Speed compositions once per
# epoch, as capenc's lib.rs requested_* parsers do for the Xorg paths. Every decision it
# makes is a shared call (pipeline_for_request, admit_auto/admit_speed, pipeline_contract);
# cursor truth, the served epoch, the rate meter and the ADMISSION line moved to
# arcen_media::video (capture_handoff, capture_admission, capture_rate, capture_notice).
# wlp-gpu-speed (2026-10-17): hosts/capenc/src/wayland/evidence.rs names capenc's own
# import routes (host-copy upload, the gpu-convert GL blit) and maps them onto the shared
# CopyPath and CaptureSourceEvidence; every admission and GPU-match decision in it is a
# shared call. It passed the ratchet before only because a route was named "EglCuda".
# hosts/capenc/src/wayland/reference.rs is the capture harness's CPU reference for those
# routes (padding-free rows, the GPU-import comparison against a host copy); only the
# harness and its qualification use it. Both move to shared/ with a second capture
# consumer of the same routes.
# wlp-recovery (2026-10-17): hosts/linux/src/session/wayland/remote.rs drives Mutter's
# RecordVirtual monitors over the session's private D-Bus (zbus) and PipeWire (capenc's
# materialise.rs, a PipeWire negotiation without pixels); output_client.rs is the Pier's
# end of the agent's unix output socket. Every decision they act on is shared
# (arcen_session::wayland_outputs: mode, layout, reconfiguration plan, generation,
# placement verification); what remains is OS fact gathering, as in mutter.rs.
# wp-multimon (2026-10-18): hosts/linux/src/session/wayland/qualify/multi_output.rs is the
# qualification command's concurrent multi-output run: it opens a headless session through
# PAM and the privileged launcher, spawns one capenc per PipeWire stream and reads their
# stats, like qualify.rs. Its only decisions are shared calls (plan_virtual_topology,
# SustainedRateMeter, MultiOutputRun::every_output_encoded); the rest is Linux session I/O.
# wp-swenc (2026-10-18): hosts/capenc/src/wayland/pipelines/software.rs is the
# linux-wayland-software composition, the sibling of auto.rs/speed.rs: it names capenc's
# PipeWire FormatOffer at the Software ceiling and calls the requested contract's shared
# admission with OpenH264. The session, Keel-gated encode loop and probe pictures it
# serves moved to arcen_media::video (software_session, software_loop).
# wp-speed (2026-10-18): hosts/capenc/src/wayland/pipelines/speed.rs is the Speed
# composition's glue: it carries capenc's argv evidence (capture-rate, its measured or
# inferred kind, the Pier's runtime shortfall) to the shared admission. Every decision
# is a shared call (admit_speed, admit_speed_after_runtime_shortfall,
# paced_source_offer_fps, CaptureRateEvidence); it passed the ratchet before only
# because nothing touched it. It moves to shared/ with pipelines/mod.rs.
# wp-cursor (2026-10-18): hosts/linux/src/media/wayland_cursor.rs is the Pier's fan-out of
# a Wayland desktop's cursor: a tokio watch channel per desktop, found by the session's
# private runtime directory, fed by capenc's framed-v2 reader and followed by each
# attachment's input-lane worker. The cursor model it holds is shared
# (arcen_input::cursor: DesktopCursor, aggregate, image registry, lane outbox).
# hosts/capenc/src/wayland/pipelines/output.rs is the stdout of every Wayland epoch
# (NVENC, wide, OpenH264): it chooses framed-v1 or framed-v2 as the parent asked and
# feeds capenc's CursorEmitter (over the PipeWire CursorState) into it. The record
# format and writer are shared (arcen_media::capenc_stream::write_record); it moves to
# shared/ with pipelines/mod.rs and wayland/cursor.rs.
